newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks end down amid Endesa speculation.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks end down amid Endesa speculation.

text.p: Speculation over a bid by Spanish power utility Endesa to move into the Chilean market unsettled investors on Tuesday, leading blue-chip stocks to close broadly weaker, said traders.
Santiago's financial markets are closed Wednesday for a public holiday to commemorate the 1973 military coup.
The bolsa will likely remain volatile on Thursday, with the focus staying on the electricity sector, said dealers.
The selective IPSA index ended down 0.08 percent at 97.58 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.13 percent to 5,340.53 points. Turnover was eight billion pesos.

Losers included telecommunications company Telex, down 2.5 percent at 1,170 pesos, copper products maker Madeco, down 2.11 percent at 930 pesos, and bottler Andina, which shed 1.07 percent at 2,315 pesos.
